bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Mike LaFleur and the medical staff evaluate C Hjalte Froholdt (concussion), QB Carson Beck (back), G Jon Gaines II (ankle), and LB Cody Simon (calf) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Darren Urban](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4430841/carson-beck#:~:text=Head%20coach%20Mike%20LaFleur%20said%20Beck%20%28back%29). DT Zachary Carter (knee) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation.

Week 12 Commanders Outlook: Mike LaFleur and DC Nick Rallis open installation for the Washington Commanders (4-5-1, WSH -7, HC Dan Quinn, OC David Blough & DC Daronte Jones (State Farm Stadium))—a unit ranked #3 in Turnover Differential (+7) as Arizona prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873092).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 3-8 (4th in NFC West • #16 Seed in NFC), Arizona carries a 0% postseason projection, 0% NFC West division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Monti Ossenfort](https://x.com/AZCardinals/status/2125683290640384075).
Around the Beat: Week 11 Film Room with @aqshipley and @jpshadrick ⬇ [Monti Ossenfort](https://x.com/AZCardinals/status/2125683290640384075).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Arizona ranks #29 in Points / Game (17.4), #31 in Points Allowed / Game (29.4), #17 in Turnover Differential (-1), giving Mike LaFleur and Nick Rallis a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 2:25 PM MST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Washington Commanders [Darren Urban](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4430841/carson-beck#:~:text=Head%20coach%20Mike%20LaFleur%20said%20Beck%20%28back%29).
